attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Illinois state income tax. Flat 4.95% rate (35 ILCS 5/201(b), unchanged since 2017) on AGI minus total personal exemptions. Exemption: $2,850/person × (taxpayers + dependents). Writes result.il_taxable_income and result.il_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.il_state_tax = 0; set result.il_taxable_income = 0; set result.il_total_exemptions = 0; add " Illinois Tax Calculation (Form IL-1040) - flat 4.95%" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.il_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.il_taxable_income xdef 0 cvd /result.il_total_exemptions xdef " Illinois Tax Calculation (Form IL-1040) - flat 4.95%" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Always compute (IL has no filing-status differences in rate/exemption-per-person)

action_details.action_comment: IL exemptions = $2,850 x (taxpayers + dependents); tax = 4.95% x max(AGI - exemptions, 0)
action_details.action_dsl: set result.il_total_exemptions = (length of job.taxpayers + length of job.dependents) * il_personal_exemption; set result.il_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - result.il_total_exemptions) and 0.0; set result.il_state_tax = result.il_taxable_income * il_tax_rate; add " IL exemptions ($2,850 per person): $" + result.il_total_exemptions to job.audit_trail; add " IL state tax (4.95%): $" + result.il_state_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: job.taxpayers length job.dependents length + il_personal_exemption fmul cvd /result.il_total_exemptions xdef result.agi result.il_total_exemptions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.il_taxable_income xdef result.il_taxable_income il_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.il_state_tax xdef " IL exemptions ($2,850 per person): $" result.il_total_exemptions strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " IL state tax (4.95%): $" result.il_state_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.il_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.il_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.il_taxable_income cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.il_state_tax cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef
